docs.title: Welcome to ReelLock
docs.text: ReelLock is an open-source Android digital wellbeing application engineered to detect and block Instagram Reels in real time, helping users eliminate infinite scrolling and reclaim focus.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• 🎯 Precision Real-Time Detection: Powered by an Android Accessibility Service targeting package com.instagram.android.
  • ⚡ 3 Blocking Modes:
  • Auto Back: Instantly triggers the Android system back button when a Reel opens.
  • Go Home: Instantly returns you to your launcher home screen.
  • Full-Screen Overlay: Displays an unbypassable blocking alert window over the Reels view.
  • 📊 Block Statistics: Local tracking of how many times ReelLock intercepted Reels.
  • 🔒 Zero Data Collection & Offline Security: No Internet permission required (INTERNET). All node tree analysis occurs 100% locally on your device.

docs.title: How It Works
docs.text:
flowchart LR
    A[User opens Instagram] --> B[ReelLock Accessibility Service]
    B --> C{Reel Detected?}
    C -- Yes --> D[Execute Action Mode]
    C -- No --> E[Allow Feed / Chat]
    D --> F[Auto Back / Go Home / Show Overlay]

docs.title: Architecture Deep-Dive
docs.text: ReelLock leverages Android's AccessibilityService API to inspect window hierarchy changes in real-time, specifically monitoring Instagram's process tree (com.instagram.android).

docs.title: High-Level System Architecture
docs.text:
graph TD
    SubGraph1[Android System Framework]
    SubGraph2[ReelLock Core Engine]

    A[Instagram App Window Event] -->|TYPE_WINDOW_CONTENT_CHANGED| B[ReelBlockerService.kt]
    A -->|TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED| B

    B --> C[Root AccessibilityNodeInfo Node]
    C --> D[Recursive Heuristic Node Inspector]

    D -->|Resource ID / Content-Desc match| E{Reel Container Detected?}

    E -- Yes --> F[Action Mode Dispatcher]
    E -- No --> G[Ignore Event]

    F -->|Mode: Auto Back| H[performGlobalAction GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK]
    F -->|Mode: Go Home| I[Intent ACTION_MAIN / CATEGORY_HOME]
    F -->|Mode: Overlay| J[WindowManager.addView Overlay Layout]

docs.title: 1. ReelBlockerService.kt
docs.text:
• Extends android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.
  • Configured via accessibility_service_config.xml to filter events from com.instagram.android.
  • Overrides onAccessibilityEvent(event: AccessibilityEvent).

docs.title: 2. Node Traversal Heuristic
docs.text: Instagram dynamically obfuscates view resource IDs across updates. ReelLock employs multi-layered heuristic checks: 1. ClassName Inspection: Identifies Reels surface views and video container view groups. 2. Resource-ID & Content-Description Matching: Looks for keywords such as clips_viewer, reels_tab, reels_video_container, and related content descriptions. 3. View Structure Parsing: Recursively traverses AccessibilityNodeInfo tree roots.

docs.title: 3. Action Execution Engine
docs.text: When a positive match occurs, ReelBlockerService executes the user's selected mode: - MODE_AUTO_BACK: Calls performGlobalAction(GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK). - MODE_GO_HOME: Launches an Intent with Intent.ACTION_MAIN and Intent.CATEGORY_HOME. - MODE_OVERLAY: Inflates overlay_reels_blocked.xml and adds it to the system window manager using TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY.

docs.title: Data Persistence & Security Model
docs.text:
• SharedPreferences: Stores mode preferences (key_block_mode) and block counts (key_block_count).
  • Privacy Assurance: ReelLock reads zero text fields, credentials, or personal messages. It strictly inspects node layout structures matching Reels video players.

docs.title: Building, Signing & GitHub Release Publishing Guide
docs.text: This guide covers building ReelLock release APKs from source, signing binaries, publishing releases on GitHub, and deploying MkDocs documentation to GitHub Pages.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• JDK: Java Development Kit 17 (OpenJDK 17 recommended).
  • Android SDK: API Level 34 (Android 14) installed.
  • Gradle: Gradle 8.2+ (managed automatically by Gradle Wrapper).
  • Android Studio: Android Studio Hedgehog (2023.1.1) or newer.

docs.title: 1. Compiling the Release APK
docs.text:
Execute ./gradlew assembleRelease from the terminal:

# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/ReelLock/ReelLock.git
cd ReelLock

# Build Production Release APK
./gradlew assembleRelease

The output APK binary will be placed at: app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk (or app-release.apk if signing is configured in build.gradle.kts).

docs.title: 2. Signing Release Binaries
docs.text:
To produce a signed release build for publication:

  1. Generate a keystore (if you don't have one): 
    keytool -genkey -v -keystore reellock-release.jks -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -alias reellock

  2. Align and sign the APK: 

    # Zipalign the APK
zipalign -v -p 4 app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk

# Sign using apksigner
apksigner sign --ks reellock-release.jks --ks-key-alias reellock --out ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk

  3. Verify the signature: 

    apksigner verify ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk

docs.title: 3. Creating SHA-256 Checksums
docs.text:
Generate SHA-256 checksum for security verification:

sha256sum ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk > ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk.sha256
cat ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk.sha256

docs.title: 4. Creating a GitHub Release
docs.text:
1. Navigate to your repository on GitHub: https://github.com/ReelLock/ReelLock/releases.
  2. Click Draft a new release.
  3. Set Tag version to v1.0.0.
  4. Set Release title to ReelLock v1.0.0 — Official Release.
  5. Paste release notes from CHANGELOG.md.
  6. Drag and drop the signed binary ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk and checksum file ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk.sha256 into the release binary attachment box.
  7. Click Publish release.

docs.title: 5. Hosting MkDocs Documentation on GitHub Pages
docs.text: The ReelLock technical documentation site is powered by MkDocs and hosted directly on GitHub Pages.

docs.title: Deployment via Command Line (gh-deploy)
docs.text:
# Install MkDocs and Material theme
pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material

# Deploy directly to the gh-pages branch
mkdocs gh-deploy --force

docs.title: GitHub Actions Automated Deployment Workflow
docs.text:
Create .github/workflows/docs.yml: 

name: Deploy Documentation
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.x
      - run: pip install mkdocs-material
      - run: mkdocs gh-deploy --force

Once pushed, GitHub Pages will automatically serve the documentation site at: 👉 https://sohamtilekar.github.io/ReelLock/

docs.title: OEM Battery Optimization Troubleshooting
docs.text:
Custom Android OEM systems (Xiaomi HyperOS/MIUI, Samsung One UI, Oppo ColorOS, Vivo FuntouchOS) aggressively kill background processes and disable Accessibility Services to save battery.

If ReelLock stops working after phone restart or extended lock periods, follow these device-specific instructions:

docs.title: Xiaomi / Redmi / Poco (HyperOS & MIUI)
docs.text:
1. Open Settings -> Apps -> Manage Apps -> ReelLock.
  2. Enable Autostart.
  3. Under Battery Saver, select No Restrictions.
  4. Lock ReelLock in the Recent Apps screen (press and hold ReelLock card -> tap lock icon).

docs.title: Samsung Galaxy (One UI)
docs.text:
1. Open Settings -> Apps -> ReelLock.
  2. Tap Battery -> select Unrestricted.
  3. Open Settings -> Device Care -> Battery -> Background usage limits -> add ReelLock to Never sleeping apps.

docs.title: OnePlus / Oppo / Realme (OxygenOS & ColorOS)
docs.text:
1. Open Settings -> Battery -> More Settings -> Optimize battery use -> set ReelLock to Don't optimize.
  2. Enable Allow background activity under App Info.

docs.title: Does ReelLock access my personal messages or Instagram data?
docs.text: No. ReelLock requires zero internet permissions (android.permission.INTERNET). It inspects view structural layouts on-device solely to identify if a Reel player view container is rendering.

docs.title: Why does Accessibility Service turn off automatically?
docs.text: Android automatically disables Accessibility Services if the app is killed by aggressive battery management software. Ensure you follow the OEM battery optimization steps above to keep ReelLock active.

docs.title: Can I still watch regular posts and IGTV videos?
docs.text: Yes! ReelLock is specifically trained to detect the Instagram Reels player container (clips_viewer / Reels tab), leaving home feed posts, stories, and direct messages completely accessible.

docs.title: User Setup & Configuration Guide
docs.text: Follow these steps to set up ReelLock on your Android device.

docs.title: Step 1: Install ReelLock
docs.text:
1. Download the latest ReelLock-v1.0.0.apk from the GitHub Releases page.
  2. Open the downloaded file and confirm installation (allow installation from unknown sources if prompted).

docs.title: Step 2: Grant System Permissions
docs.text: Launch ReelLock from your launcher. You will see two permission configuration cards:

docs.title: 1. Enable Accessibility Service (Required)
docs.text:
1. Tap Enable Accessibility Service in the ReelLock app dashboard.
  2. Android system settings will open. Navigate to Installed Apps or Downloaded Services.
  3. Select ReelLock and switch the toggle to ON.
  4. Confirm system warning dialogs.

[!NOTE] Accessibility Service permission is essential for ReelLock to detect when Instagram Reels views are launched.

docs.title: 2. Grant Overlay Permission (Required for Overlay Mode)
docs.text:
1. If you plan to use Overlay Mode, tap Grant Overlay Permission.
  2. Switch the Allow display over other apps toggle to ON for ReelLock.

docs.title: Step 3: Choose Your Blocking Action Mode
docs.text:
In the ReelLock control dashboard, select your preferred blocking behavior:

Mode Behavior Best Used For ↩️ Auto Press Back Triggers Android back button instantly when a Reel opens, taking you back to your feed or previous screen. Frictionless feed browsing without Reels. 🏠 Go to Home Screen Instantly sends you to your launcher home screen. Complete break from phone usage. ⛔ Blocker Overlay Displays a full-screen alert overlay over the Reel preventing video viewing. Conscious habit breaking & awareness.

docs.title: Step 4: Verification
docs.text: Open Instagram and navigate to the Reels tab or tap a Reel in your feed. ReelLock will immediately intervene according to your chosen mode!
